Job Description

- Ensure HBB end-to-end network elements incident (infrastructure) & Quality Performance, network configuration & integration management and services, monitoring, tracking and problem management are handled excellently according to network KPI, agreed SLA, and standard methodology, for 24 hours/day, 7 days/week and to avoid any service degradation and company revenue loss.

Area of Responsibilities

Key Activities

• Network Fault Monitoring & Management

• Manage the Network & services problem tracking as single point of contact for problem status information.
• Lead in evaluating and improving the performance of service problem tracking system.
• External Relation
• Serve as a company representative for external related functions

In order to build good network in the industry and keep up to date with new trends

Managing HBB Network Manage Service:

• Ensure on time Daily, Weekly and Monthly HBB Network Report.
• Ensure on time Weekly SLA Achievement, Weekly HBB KPI achievement

Requirement

Qualification:

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science, or a related field.
• Strong understanding of FTTH and FWA technologies and network architecture principles.
• Knowledge of regulatory requirements and industry standards for telecommunications.

Experience:

• At least 5 years of experience in telecommunications network planning and engineering.
• Proven track record in designing and deploying FTTH and FWA networks.
• Familiarity with emerging home broadband technologies and industry trends.

Skills:

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills for fault management.
• Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
• Effective communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams.
• Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills for documentation and reporting.

Ability to adapt to rapidly changing technologies and business needs

Job Responsibilities

Operational Excellence
Operational Issue Resolution
Operational Management and Performance Monitoring
Operational Performance Monitoring

wo-jpfa-JR4276.d:
PT JAPFA COMFEED INDONESIA Tbk. - UNIT TANGERANG
POSITION: ENTRANCE CONTROL WORKER (FEED TANGERANG)

1. Raw Material Receiving Inspection and Sampling

• Carry out and prepare raw material receiving inspections in accordance with established work instructions and quality standards.
• Perform pre-sampling and unloading sampling for various types of raw materials, including: Bagged raw materials delivered by truck. Bulk raw materials delivered by truck. Liquid raw materials delivered by tanker. Bagged raw materials delivered in containers. Bulk raw materials delivered in containers. Jumbo bag raw materials delivered in containers. Bulk raw materials unloaded from vessel cargo holds. Feed additives.
• Ensure all sampling activities are conducted correctly to support raw material acceptance or rejection decisions.
• Verify that received raw materials meet the company's specifications and quality requirements.

2. Raw Material Sample Retention
• Store and manage raw material samples in accordance with applicable sample retention and filing procedures.
• Ensure all samples are properly identified, labeled, and traceable.
• Maintain accurate and systematic sample retention records and data.

3. Sample Preparation and Reduction
• Perform sample preparation and reduction activities according to established work instructions.
• Ensure samples submitted to the Quality Control and Laboratory sections accurately represent the actual condition of raw materials.
• Preserve sample integrity throughout the preparation and reduction process.
• Complete all required checklists and documentation related to sample preparation activities.

4. Raw Material Quick Testing
• Conduct quick tests on received raw materials in accordance with applicable procedures.
• Record and report test results accurately and promptly.
• Identify raw materials that do not meet quality standards and notify the relevant parties for further evaluation.
• Support quality control activities by providing accurate and reliable testing data.

5. Aflatoxin Reading Validation
• Perform validation of aflatoxin readings against master references according to the established schedule.
• Ensure deviations in reading results remain within specified tolerance limits.
• Maintain validation records and prepare monthly aflatoxin validation reports.
• Support the accuracy and consistency of aflatoxin testing results.

6. Occupational Health, Safety, and Housekeeping
• Implement and promote the 5S program (Sort, Set in Order, Shine, Standardize, and Sustain) within the work area.
• Comply with and enforce company Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) standards.
• Maintain a safe, clean, organized, and orderly working environment.
• Participate in hazard identification and workplace accident prevention programs.

7. Coordination and Compliance
• Coordinate with Quality Control, Production, Warehouse, Purchasing, and other related departments.
• Ensure all activities are carried out in compliance with company policies, quality standards, and applicable regulations.
• Maintain positive working relationships with both internal and external stakeholders.
• Support and uphold the company’s positive image through adherence to procedures and professional work ethics.

8. Continuous Improvement
• Develop competencies through relevant training and learning opportunities.
• Provide recommendations to improve operational effectiveness and efficiency.
• Participate in continuous improvement and quality enhancement programs.
• Support the implementation of approved improvement initiatives.

9. Inventory Management
• Manage inventories related to operational activities within the scope of responsibility.
• Monitor and maintain the availability of sampling equipment, tools, and supporting materials.
• Ensure company assets and inventory are utilized effectively and in accordance with company requirements.
• Prepare inventory reports as required by the department.

10. Document and Data Management
• Ensure the availability, completeness, accuracy, and confidentiality of documents under responsibility.
• Maintain SOPs, work instructions, testing data, reports, and other supporting documents.
• Ensure all documentation is up-to-date, well-organized, and easily retrievable.
• Support departmental audits and document control requirements.

11. Industrial Relations and Teamwork
• Maintain harmonious working relationships with supervisors, colleagues, subordinates, and other departments.
• Promote effective teamwork and a positive working environment.
• Support effective cross-functional communication throughout the organization.

12. Additional Duties
• Perform other duties assigned by the immediate supervisor within the scope of the position.
• Support departmental and company operational requirements as needed.

13. Workplace Environment Management
• Maintain a healthy, clean, organized, and well-maintained work environment.
• Ensure work areas and equipment are properly arranged to support operational effectiveness.
• Minimize disturbances that may affect productivity and workplace safety.

PT JAPFA COMFEED INDONESIA Tbk. - UNIT TANGERANG
POSISI: ENTRANCE CONTROL WORKER (FEED TANGERANG)

1. Pemeriksaan Penerimaan dan Pengambilan Sampel Bahan Baku

• Melaksanakan dan mempersiapkan kegiatan pemeriksaan penerimaan bahan baku sesuai instruksi kerja dan standar kualitas yang berlaku.
• Melakukan presampling dan unloading sampling untuk berbagai jenis bahan baku, meliputi: Bahan baku dalam karung yang dikirim menggunakan truk.Bahan baku curah yang dikirim menggunakan truk.Bahan baku cair yang dikirim menggunakan tangki.Bahan baku dalam karung yang dikirim menggunakan kontainer.Bahan baku curah yang dikirim menggunakan kontainer.Bahan baku dalam jumbo bag yang dikirim menggunakan kontainer.Bahan baku curah yang dibongkar dari palka kapal.Feed Additive.
• Memastikan proses sampling dilakukan dengan benar untuk mendukung keputusan penerimaan atau penolakan bahan baku.
• Memastikan bahan baku yang diterima memenuhi spesifikasi dan persyaratan kualitas perusahaan.

2. Penyimpanan Sampel Bahan Baku

• Menyimpan dan mengelola sampel bahan baku sesuai prosedur filing dan penyimpanan sampel yang berlaku.
• Memastikan setiap sampel diberi identifikasi, label, dan dapat ditelusuri dengan baik.
• Memelihara data dan catatan penyimpanan sampel secara akurat dan sistematis.

3. Preparasi dan Reduksi Sampel

• Melaksanakan proses preparasi dan reduksi sampel sesuai instruksi kerja yang berlaku.
• Memastikan sampel yang dikirim ke bagian Quality Control dan Laboratorium mewakili kondisi bahan baku yang sebenarnya.
• Menjaga integritas sampel selama proses preparasi dan reduksi.
• Melengkapi checklist dan dokumentasi yang terkait dengan kegiatan preparasi sampel.

4. Pengujian Cepat (Quick Test) Bahan Baku

• Melaksanakan pengujian cepat (quick test) terhadap bahan baku yang diterima sesuai prosedur yang berlaku.
• Mencatat dan melaporkan hasil pengujian secara akurat dan tepat waktu.
• Mengidentifikasi bahan baku yang tidak memenuhi standar serta menginformasikannya kepada pihak terkait untuk evaluasi lebih lanjut.
• Mendukung kegiatan pengendalian kualitas melalui penyediaan data pengujian yang akurat dan terpercaya.

5. Validasi Pembacaan Aflatoksin

• Melaksanakan validasi pembacaan aflatoksin terhadap master reference sesuai jadwal yang telah ditetapkan.
• Memastikan deviasi hasil pembacaan tetap berada dalam batas toleransi yang ditentukan.
• Menyimpan catatan validasi dan menyiapkan laporan validasi aflatoksin bulanan.
• Mendukung keakuratan dan konsistensi hasil pengujian aflatoksin.

6. Keselamatan, Kesehatan Kerja dan Housekeeping

• Melaksanakan dan mengembangkan program 5S (Seiri, Seiton, Seiso, Seiketsu, dan Shitsuke) di area kerja.
• Mematuhi dan menerapkan standar Keselamatan dan Kesehatan Kerja (K3) perusahaan.
• Menjaga lingkungan kerja yang aman, bersih, rapi, dan terorganisir.
